data_description.enable_gateway_monitoring: Each poll, ping the gateway and the next two hops toward the internet: latency, jitter and packet loss.
data_description.enable_dns_monitoring: Each poll, time one uncached lookup at the DNS server below.
data_description.dns_server: Server whose lookup time is measured. Auto-detect uses the one this host is configured with.
data_description.ping_count: Pings sent to each target every poll (1 to 10). More pings give steadier readings and finer packet loss.
data_description.hop_ownership: Off by default. Shows the network operator (ASN) of each public hop. Sends those hop addresses (your ISP's routers, not your own address) to Team Cymru's free IP-to-ASN service, through your DNS server. Private and shared ISP addresses have no owner and are never sent.

traceroute_missing.title: traceroute is not installed
traceroute_missing.description: Internet Health Monitor needs `traceroute` to find hops 2 and 3, so those sensors stay unknown. Install it on the Home Assistant host (`apt install traceroute` or `apk add traceroute`), then reload the integration. Gateway and DNS monitoring keep working.
